text: My daily routine is very important to me because it helps me stay organized and healthy. Every morning, I wake up at seven o'clock, drink a glass of water, and eat a quick breakfast. I usually start work at nine and finish around five in the afternoon. After work, I go to the gym or run in the park for about an hour. In the evening, I cook dinner, watch a little TV, and read a book before bed. I try to keep the same schedule every day, because consistency gives me energy and helps me feel calm and focused.
